CommunityApplications.Profile: Community Apps templates maintained by Aurial. Currently two apps: **Strata AMD** — a template for the official ROCm builds of [Strata](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata), which runs the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next mixture-of-experts model on AMD Radeon GPUs (RX 7000, RX 9000, Radeon AI PRO R9700, Ryzen AI Max) in Unraid; and **Phonon TTS** — a template for the official OpenAI-compatible speech server of [Phonon](https://github.com/gradium-ai/xn-ptts), Gradium's open-weight on-device text-to-speech models, running CPU-only. Template and Unraid problems: open an issue in this repository. Problems with the apps themselves: the upstream links above.
